title: sca-v21-MVP SOTA-Repo Verdict
description: Strict superset of sca-v20-multi-dim. MVP per codex W380-r1 convergence (REVISE@0.86 → MVP-endorsed): output of the executable scorer + raw ledger capture + per-dimension evidence-quality/missingness (the codex-flagged missed-high-value). Weights FROZEN at v20 defaults — fitted calibration deferred until a 50-repo stratified backtest exists (codex P0: avoid n=12 overfit). Stars informational-only (MALTA fake-star check inherited). 5-tier soft-gate routing (INSTALL/PATTERN-STUDY/CITE-ONLY/MONITOR/BLOCK), soft-route-down only. Per-decision-class Pareto-frontier preserved (no single scalar). Authored 2026-05-23 from W380 STREAM-C + 4-stream synthesis + codex W380-r1.

weights_profile.description: Frozen-weights identifier. Codex W380-r1 P0: NOT tuned on n=12; awaits 50-repo backtest.

dims.description: Raw dimension values per contract.mjs DIMS registry. null when no fetcher measured the dim.

evidence.description: Per-dimension EvidenceAnchor. REQUIRED for every dim in the contract registry — codex W380-r1 MISSED_HIGH_VALUE: missingness rides alongside value so 'clean', 'not-measurable', and 'conflicting' never collapse to one neutral number.

value.description: raw value (number, string, bool, obj, or null)

per_class_scores.description: Per-decision-class weighted scores (Pareto-frontier preserved — NO single scalar).

tier.description: 5-tier soft-gate. Hard-BLOCK on CISA-KEV (D22) or proprietary/noassertion license. Hard-filter violations route DOWN only, never silently UP.

hard_filter_violations.description: Per-class hard-filter violations that downgraded from a higher tier — transparency record.

confidence.description: Top-level confidence discounted by the measured-evidence ratio (codex: unknown != clean).

measured_ratio.description: Fraction of registered dims with missingness=measured. Drives confidence.

fetcher_versions.description: Per-fetcher version stamp for reproducibility (codex W380-r1 P1: version fetchers, record missingness).

lineage.description: Pointer back to design provenance for cite-anchor discipline (CR-6).
